subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Pigeon Drop
description: A fast breakdown of The Pigeon Drop for builders.

hook.text: A stranger finds an envelope of cash on the ground. They offer to split it with you.

buildup.text: There's one catch: you need to put up 'good faith' money to prove you're trustworthy.

discovery.text: Once you hand over your cash, both the stranger and the envelope vanish.

twist.text: The 'found' money was either fake or swapped for worthless paper at the last second.

climax.text: The pigeon drop works because greed overrides the obvious question: why would a stranger share?

punchline.text: Free money has a price. It's usually yours.

quiz.question: What does the pigeon drop victim have to provide?
